author: Gian López
abstract: Standard for creating, extending and auditing a company's brand design system: process, naming, color, surfaces, brand assets, print production, foundations, writing, iconography, components, communication pieces and governance. It describes how every piece derived from a brand must look and be documented, not a specific website, app or presentation, and uses the ASK TECHNOLOGY S.A.S. (ASKIT) system as the worked reference.
